These modules were helpers of the deleted PostgresDatabase and account for 463 of the errors: storage/knowledge.rs (184), storage/fems_memory.rs (72), storage/knowledge_crdt.rs (46), plus knowledge_memory, knowledge_retrieval, kb003_storage, block_view_outbox, calendar, retention and loom.
